description: Hydrologically-aware hybrid forecaster that dynamically switches between local persistence (baseflow regime) and multi-station ridge regression (surge regime), with safe fallback to persistence when upstream telemetry drops (degraded regime).

BASEFLOW.description: Quiescent river stage under stable hydrological conditions. Local river stage changes very slowly, making 1-hour lagged stage persistence the optimal low-variance predictor.

SURGE.description: Hydrological surge driven by heavy cumulative rainfall, sudden precipitation bursts, or rapid upstream stage acceleration at Shigaon or Koyna Dam. Multi-station ridge regression captures upstream hydrograph pulse propagation.

DEGRADED.description: Sensor failure, transmission latency, or missing telemetry in upstream river gauges or rainfall station, while local Ankali gauge remains functional. Graceful fallback to local persistence.

DEGRADED_UNUSABLE.description: Local Ankali Bridge river gauge telemetry is unavailable. No forecast can be produced safely.

hysteresis.rationale: Prevents rapid oscillation between regimes during flood hydrograph crests when instantaneous rate of stage change (dh/dt) temporarily approaches zero.
